programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: After tonights special show, Caroline Munro is here to tell us what is coming up next week at the Cellar Club.

programme.title: Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense
programme.desc: The Sweet Scent of Death. 1984. Stars Dean Stockwell & Shirley Knight. A US ambassador takes his wife to a beautiful country home, but their trip quickly turns into a nightmare.

programme.title: White Cargo
programme.desc: 1973. Comedy. Day-dreamer, Albert (David Jason) has hopes of being a superhero and saving the girls.

programme.title: The Adventures of Bullwhip Griffin
programme.desc: 1967. Western. Director: James Neilson. Stars Roddy McDowall, Suzanne Pleshette & Karl Malden. To restore his family's wealth, a young lad stows away on a ship bound for the California Gold Rush.

programme.title: Travellers Yarn
programme.desc: See the Armstrong Siddeley, Morris Oxford, Dennis & Bedford Fire engines, speedway and much more as we look at how high-tenacity rayon cords enables tyres to withstand the stresses of a 'modern' car.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Big Skate/Pannage. 1986. Jack Hargreaves recounts a trip to Shetland in search of large fish. In his second film, he witnesses pigs dealing with a bumper crop of acorns.

programme.title: The Cisco Kid: South of Rio Grande
programme.desc: 1945. Western. Director Lambert Hillyer. Stars Duncan Renaldo, Martin Garralaga & Armida. Cisco and Pancho infiltrate the operations of Miguel Sanches and free the district from his control.

programme.title: Mary Had A Little Lamb
programme.desc: 1949. A charming puppet animation film about road safety.

programme.title: The Black Arrow
programme.desc: The Adventure of the Holy Finger. 1974. Stars Robert Russell, Edward Brayshaw & Deddie Davies. A crazed woman summons Sir Richard and Peterkin to help strange travellers who carry treasure.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Ram is banished to the outlands by the king after losing a battle with Dean, and begins plotting his revenge.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Ruby of Radnor. 1957. Stars: William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. As punishment Squire Brian is sent on an errand delivering a crate of pigeons to a neighbouring castle.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Enter Batgirl, Exit Penguin. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Yvonne Craig. Batman and Robin find out just how valuable their new ally is when they are hopelessly strung up in Penguin's lair.

programme.title: The Roy Rogers Show
programme.desc: The Big Chance. 1955. Stars Roy Rogers, Trigger & Dale Evans. Pat is kidnapped by an outlaw gang, one of whom may be in line for a million dollar inheritance.

programme.title: Captain Scarlet and the Mysterons
programme.desc: Manhunt. 1967. Stars Paul Maxwell, Janna Hill & Francis Matthews. The hunt is on to apprehend Captain Black, after he inadvertently becomes a radioactive hotspot...

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: Landslide. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Tell comes face to face with his exact double - an Austrian imported by Gessler to impersonate the resistance leader.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Marooned. 1956. Stars Robert Shaw, Bill Owen & Peter Hammond. Shortly after capturing Captain Clip West, the tables turn, resulting in Tempest and his men being marooned on an island.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Thorkil Ghost. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Barbara Mullen. A young man tells Robin of hidden treasure in a castle that his late father had an encounter with a Viking ghost.

programme.title: Planet Outlaws
programme.desc: 1953. Sci-fi. Directors: Ford Beebe & Saul Goodkind. Stars Buster Crabbe, Constance Moore & Jackie Moran. Buck Rogers and his friend Buddy wake up 500 years in the future to an outlaw ruled world.

programme.title: North West Frontier
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: J. Lee Thompson. Stars Kenneth More, Lauren Bacall & Herbert Lom. In British India, a prince must be taken to safety across a rebel-held territory.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: The Actress. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Jennifer Jayne & Lew Luton. An attractive actress is kidnapped by Mike Upton. Cobb tries to rescue her until they run into some angry gold miners.

programme.title: Hobson's Choice
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: David Lean. Stars Charles Laughton, John Mills & Brenda de Banzie. Henry Hobson's three daughters want to marry, but he refuses as traditions require him to pay settlements.

programme.title: Look At Life Down to Earth
programme.desc: 1966. An exciting look at some of the girls of the WRAF who trekked into the jungle, and who also take part in a jungle survival exercise, parachute jumps, and sub-aqua diving.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Amateurs. 1962. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Helen Shingler. Maigret holds the suspicion that a recently released criminal is responsible for a number of daring holdups in Paris.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: A Present Sovereign. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Donald Burton. A determined and kind hearted woman embarks on her career to be the best cook in England.

programme.title: Play of the Month: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: 1974. Drama. Director: James MacTaggart. Stars Stanley Baker, Ram John Holder & Jerome Willis. A man struggles to survive after being shipwrecked on a deserted island.

programme.title: The Blue Lagoon
programme.desc: 1980. Drama. Directed by Randal Kleiser. Stars Christopher Atkins, Brooke Shields & Leo McKern. Two children are stranded on an enchanting island and experience the mysteries of adolescence.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1994. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and Jean Paul Gaultier. Jean Paul interviews John Waters, Victoria Abril, and Germany's biggest pop phenomenon, the Irish-American Kelly Family.

programme.title: Warm Nights and Hot Pleasures
programme.desc: 1964. Director: Joseph W. Sarno. Stars Marla Ellis, Eve Harris & Sheila Britt. Three friends want to become stars, they ensure endless frauds and casting couches which put a strain on their bond.

programme.title: 100 Years of Horror
programme.desc: 1998. Documentary. Directed by Ted Newson. King of Horror, Christopher Lee, takes us on a frightening journey from the earliest horror movies to modern day slashers!

programme.title: Look At Life Hot History
programme.desc: 1968. A brilliant look at the work of the Press Association with its teleprinters and fast movement to get the news out.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Theft of Excalibur. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. A knight is held to ransom. The price for his release is King Arthur's sword, Excalibur.

programme.title: Stingray
programme.desc: A Christmas to Remember. 1964. Stars Don Mason, David Graham & Ray Barrett. When Troy meets the orphaned son of an ex-WASP aquanaut, he decides to give the boy a Christmas to remember.

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Matter of Wife and Death. Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and starring Anne Francis. Someone tries to sink a ship carrying Honey and a woman who hired her.

programme.title: Tarzan and the Trappers
programme.desc: 1960. Adventure. Directed by Charles F. Haas & Sandy Howard. Stars Gordon Scott, Eve Brent & Rickie Sorensen. Tarzan must fight off the vengeful brother of a ruthless hunter he defeated.

programme.title: The Christmas Tree
programme.desc: 1966. Family. Starring Brian Blessed, William Burleigh, Anthony Honour & Kate Nicholls. Gary determines to get a tree for children who will be in hospital for Christmas. Directed by Jim Clark.

programme.title: Fiend Without A Face
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Director: Arthur Crabtree. Stars Marshall Thompson & Terry Kilburn. A captain is assigned to investigate disappearances that residents are blaming on nuclear experiments.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Son of Lafe Returns. 1964. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Conlan Carter & Donna Douglas. Lafe Crick brings his son, Dub, to Beverly Hills to try some match making between him and Elly, but Jed is suspicious.

programme.title: The Kansan
programme.desc: 1943. Western. Directed by George Archainbaud. Stars Richard Dix, Jane Wyatt & Albert Dekker. A cowboy's life takes a turn after he stops a gang of thieves from robbing a bank in the town.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Caught in the Spiders Den. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. Black widow manages to take over the duo's brains again and continues her crime spree using the perfect disguise!

programme.title: The Railway Children
programme.desc: 2000. Drama. Directed by Catherine Morshead. Stars Jenny Agutter & Richard Attenborough. Three children are forced to move to Yorkshire with their mother after their father is falsely imprisoned.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1961. The Silent Weapon. Directed by Peter Duffell. Staring Geoffrey Keen, Stanley Morgan and Norma Parnell. A horse rider is found dead in suspicious circumstances. (S1, E35)

programme.title: Give Us A Clue
programme.desc: 1985. The classic game show Give us a Clue hosted by Michael Parkinson, this week's guests are Bobby Crush, Jenny Hanley, Mike Read, Joan Sims, Bernie Winters & Lena Zavaroni.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The King of Knaves Affair. 1964. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Paul Stevens. A Middle Eastern leader is plotting to ruin the economy. Solo & Kuryakin adopt aliases to foil the plan.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: We ride back to Devon in 1955; a reel takes us to Sunderland in the 70s with Sir Tommy Steele! There's footage of British bandleader Henry Hall and we talk Titch & Quackers.

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: Coup de Grace. 1989. Stars Robert Powell, Anthony Valentine & Joanna David. Hannay becomes ensnared by a web of lies when he meets the beautiful Sybil Verney at a race meeting.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Only When it Hurts. 1983. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Jennifer Lonsdale. Ida breaks her tooth on Mrs Price's sausage rolls. How will she get on at her first dentist trip in 28 years?

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Dead Man's Evidence. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, John Stone & Brian Worth. Blackmail and greed turn grave when Dick notices a secret affair. Things all change when a fight ends in manslaughter.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Penny Plains. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. An attempt is made on a wealthy woman's life. Marriott is put on the case but finds himself falling for her.

programme.title: Who Do You Do?
programme.desc: 1972. With Freddie Starr and Peter Goodwright, guest acts such as Paul Melba, Janet Brown and Dawson Chance and play a number of roles in a series of sketches and songs!

programme.title: Adventures of a Private Eye
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Suzy Kendall, Harry H. Corbett. While his boss is away, Bob helps a model being blackmailed, finds a dead body & ends up in a cabaret club.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.
